data.name: Jamil
data.long_meaning: The name Jamil is derived from the Arabic word 'jamila' which means beautiful, handsome, and elegant. In Islamic tradition, Jamil is considered to be a name of God, representing His beauty and grace. The name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Mulk, where God is described as 'Al-Jameel' – The Beautiful One.

in_arabic.name: جميل
in_arabic.meaning: جميل يعني الشخص الحسن الوجه أو الجميل في الأخلاق
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جميل مشتق من الجمال، وهو وصف للشخص الذي يتميز بحسن الخلق أو الجمال الحسي. الجمال في اللغة العربية يعني الزيادة في الحسن، ومنه جاءت التسمية بهذا الاسم للدلالة على الشخص الذي يحسن إلى الناس أو يتميز بجمال أخلاقه. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الجمال في سياق وصفه تعالى للخالق، فالله جميل يحب الجمال.

in_hindi.name: जमील
in_hindi.meaning: जमील नाम का अर्थ है सुंदरता या अच्छे चरित्र वाला व्यक्ति

in_english.name: Jamil
in_english.meaning: Jamil means beautiful, handsome, or good character
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jamil is derived from the Arabic root 'J-M-L', which means beauty or handsome. It is used to describe someone with a beautiful face or good character. In Islamic tradition, Jamil is associated with good morals and kindness. The name has been used historically across various Muslim cultures to signify someone who is not only physically attractive but also possesses inner beauty and good deeds.
